# Holocron

> Holocron is a Go network video recorder: one executable (`holocron`) records RTSP cameras with ffmpeg, supervises its own processes, serves a web app and alerts. It replaced the PowerShell system on 2026-10-22; that system was retired from this repository on 2026-10-28 and lives complete in the repository `windows-terminal-IPCCTV-dashboard` (branch `master`), the rollback target.

Branch `main`. Rules for agents are in AGENTS.md. Facts in the documents below carry file paths; items marked UNVERIFIED have not been run.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): hard rules for any AI agent working in this repository (never touch the live system, no credential files, commit rules, how to run tests)
- [Holocron for agents](docs/ai/holocron-for-agents.md): the full structured reference - architecture, package map, command registry, guarantees G1 to G15 and their tests, configuration, state files, access classes, per-OS process lifetime, testing, how to extend, limits, glossary
- [Quickstart](docs/holocron-quickstart.md): four steps from nothing to a recording NVR, Windows first, then Linux and macOS
- [Cheat sheet](docs/holocron-cheatsheet.md): commands by intent, files, ports, exit codes, alert ids, the ten likeliest problems, rollback in four lines

## Operating

- [Rollback](docs/rollback.md): a previous build, the flat archive layout (`holocron archive flatten`), and the Holocron side of going back to the PowerShell system
- [Autostart](docs/autostart.md): `holocron install`, logon task, Windows service, systemd, launchd, Defender note
- [The web app](docs/ui.md): screens, Live view, HTTPS on the LAN, users, roles, the Admin tab
- [Alerts](docs/alerts.md): event ids and meanings
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): the two files, where they live, the keys by area
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptoms, the doctor lines and their fixes
- [How it works](docs/how-it-works.md): recording, the relay, the mover, the pruner, autostart
- [Known limitations](docs/limitations.md): measured or code-visible limits (two RTSP sessions per camera, GOP overshoot, Firefox and loopback media)
- [Comparing two archives](docs/shadow.md): `holocron archive compare`, read-only on both roots
- [Development](docs/development.md): building, testing, the documentation checks, golden files
- [Continuous integration](docs/ci.md): what runs, how to run the same locally
- [Releasing](docs/releasing.md): when a version is cut, the advisor's release checklist, what the release workflow does, rollback, how to verify a download, the one-time repository settings
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): every version's changes and the versioning policy
- [Cutover plan and record](tasks/holocron/cutover-plan.md): decisions, stop rules, the 22 Oct 2026 record and its findings; the step-by-step [cutover runbook](tasks/holocron/cutover-runbook.md) and [shadow runbook](tasks/holocron/shadow-runbook.md) are historical records

## Design and decisions

- [Low-level design](tasks/holocron/os-independent-lld.md): per-package plan and the work items
- [Supervisor inventory](tasks/holocron/spec/inventory-supervisor.md): the guarantees G1 to G15 and the status.json fields of the system Holocron reproduces
- [Commission ledger](tasks/holocron/ledger.md): every merge into `main`
- [Configuration keys](internal/config/KEYS.md): every `holocron.config.json` key, default, rule and whether `config set` may edit it
